title:
This type handles parsing of Markdown and rendering into other formats. In particular, the C3 markdown flavor is
[CommonMark](https://commonmark.org/) with some [GitHub extensions](https://github.github.com/gfm/):
  - heading anchors
  - tables
  - strikethrough

JavaDoc style links and images using `{@link}` and `{@img}` are supported, which get translated into a normal
Markdown link and image references. Finally, type/field references are supported using a hash mark such as:
`Type#field` (anywhere) or just `#field` (in a .c3typ file where the type provides context).

Math expressions in LaTeX are supported using double dollar sign (`$$`) delimiters. When used in a block with
other content, it will be inline and when in as a paragraph by itself it will be display style.
Note that due to poor browser support for [MathML](https://www.w3.org/Math/), this requires shimming with
[MathJax](https://www.mathjax.org/).

Tabbed content is also supported using the alternate (ATX) heading style with equal signs instead of hash marks.

Diagrams are supported as fenced code blocks with "```mermaid".

Raw HTML tags are not supported in Markdown and will be rendered as plain text. That means that natural type
names can be used and so "Array<Obj>" will render naturally (the `<` and `>` are treated as plain text).

@see https://commonmark.org/
@see https://github.github.com/gfm/
@see https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/LaTeX/Mathematics
@see https://mermaid.js.org/intro/
